Preserve the existing green leaf sprays exactly, same framing, same central zoom anchor, same upper-left warm sunlight, no zoom or composition change. Preserve any ladybug, ant and dew with exact positions, sizes, poses and shadows. Photorealistic photographic texture, no text.

foreground.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target is this square green sequoia macro photograph. Create a separate foreground image for parallax compositing. Keep ONLY the single bright foreground leafy spray crossing the centre from right edge towards left, including its connected overlapping green needle leaves. Preserve this spray pixel alignment, exact scale, position, same canvas and framing; preserve ladybug, ant, dew and their contact shadows if present on this spray. Remove EVERYTHING behind this spray to genuine transparency: other upper, left and lower background foliage. Natural precise needle edges, no halos, no rectangle, no drop shadows outside real leaf contact. Do not enlarge, move, rotate or reframe anything. No new objects. This is a cutout of the central foreground leaf spray in its original full-frame coordinates.

All foliage behind: no insects, no droplets, no exposed brown/orange bark or wood anywhere. Keep square framing, same surrounding leaf arrangement, sunlight upper left, same scale. Photorealistic reasonably sharp background foliage texture; do not bake in strong blur, blur will be applied separately in software. No text.
